title: 009 neotresitelny
prompt: Wide dramatic shot of a sturdy stone castle standing completely unshaken on a solid rock hill during a violent earthquake and storm, around it the ground cracks open, trees fall and a wooden village below collapses in dust, but the castle on its massive stone base stands perfectly upright and intact, lightning in dark clouds, a warm ray of sunlight on the castle. No visible people. Palette: storm grey, dust brown, warm golden light on the castle, no teal. No text.
